title: Generative AI Technical Lead
key_deliverables: Architect and scale multi-agent reasoning systems using LangGraph or custom execution loops.
Deploy low-latency LLM inference pipelines with vLLM / TensorRT-LLM and speculative decoding.
Formulate evaluation datasets (Evals) to quantitatively track model hallucination and task accuracy.
interview_question_samples: How do you design a stateful multi-agent system where agents verify each other's outputs before taking real-world actions?
Walk me through your optimization strategy when inference latency for a 70B parameter model spikes from 80ms to 450ms.
How do you align RAG semantic chunking strategies with vector distance metrics to minimize hallucination?

title: Cloud Security & DevSecOps Lead
key_deliverables: Embed automated security gating (SAST/DAST/SCA) in GitHub Actions / GitLab CI pipelines.
Design zero-trust IAM policies and least-privilege role boundaries across multi-account AWS/Azure.
Conduct continuous cloud security posture management (CSPM) and lead threat containment workflows.
interview_question_samples: Describe how you detect and neutralize an IAM privilege escalation attack occurring within an AWS ECS/EKS cluster.
How do you enforce infrastructure-as-code guardrails across 40 different engineering teams without blocking deployment velocity?
Walk me through your post-incident analysis for an exposed S3 bucket or compromised API key.

title: AI Governance & Algorithmic Ethics Director
key_deliverables: Establish enterprise compliance roadmap for EU AI Act high-risk systems and ISO/IEC 42001.
Implement model risk management, algorithmic bias testing, and third-party AI vendor audits.
Interface with board risk committees, external regulators, and legal counsel on algorithmic safety.
interview_question_samples: How do you operationalize the EU AI Act technical documentation requirements for a high-risk production AI workflow?
Describe a situation where you had to pause an AI product launch due to ethical or bias concerns. How did you manage executive pushback?
How do you establish continuous monitoring for model drift from a compliance and risk perspective?

title: Principal Platform & Cloud Architect
key_deliverables: Architect resilient multi-region Kubernetes platform clusters handling mission-critical enterprise workloads.
Define GitOps delivery workflows and self-service developer platform portals (Backstage / ArgoCD).
Establish observability architectures (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Datadog) and incident SLIs/SLOs.
interview_question_samples: How do you design a zero-downtime database migration and traffic cutover across two separate cloud regions?
Walk through your strategy for platform engineering self-service that reduces developer onboarding time by 80%.
How do you architect a Kubernetes disaster recovery plan with an RTO under 5 minutes and RPO under 30 seconds?
